content.text:
I think it's worth having, but I'd want you to help me pick how the money is invested before I sign anything.

The page says a keren hishtalmut is savings where every month the employer puts money in on top of the salary, and I put in part of my salary too. The words I held on to were "אחרי 6 שנים מההפקדה הראשונה אפשר למשוך את הכסף בלי מס הכנסה ובלי מס רווחי הון". So after six years I can take it out without tax. I can also take it out earlier, but then I pay tax. There was a red "−13,974 ₪" under the word "המס" on the five-year example, and that scared me off taking it early. As I understood it, the reason to have it is that the employer adds more than I do. In their example I put in "18,000 ₪" and the employer added "+54,000 ₪". That's a lot of money to give up.

What worries me is that it isn't a deposit. The money goes into a "מסלול השקעה", and the choices include "S&P 500" and "מדד" ones, the same kind of thing as that fund that fell on me years ago. There's also a management fee of "עד 2% בשנה" taken from everything saved, and I don't know how much my company will take. I'm fairly sure about the six years and the employer's money. I'm not sure which track is safe, and I'd ask you or the bank before choosing.

**What I looked at, in order:**
1. The title and "מה זה". I read this most carefully, including the part about early withdrawal and tax.
2. "למה משתמשים בזה". It said the employer usually deposits for salaried workers, and the profits are tax-free at the end.
3. A coloured bar chart with many numbers for "after 5 years". It made me nervous. I only took in the 18,000, the +54,000 and the red minus.
4. "שווה לדעת". It repeated the six years without tax.
5. "כסף נכנס ויוצא". It said "כשעוברות 6 שנים" and that the money arrives "עד 4 ימי עסקים". That was clear.
6. "כמה זה עולה". The fee is "עד 2% בשנה" and there's no fee for withdrawing ("דמי יציאה – אין"). I only glanced at the top of "מיסוי".

After that I was tired and stopped. I didn't get to "סיכונים ומה לא מוגן" or "מונחים".

**What I skipped:** the coloured buttons ("S&P 500 מדד", "אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה", "מזומן שקלי"), the folded "שחקו עם המספרים שלכם" and "הצגת החברות", the small tags like "TXH-09", "KH-15", "חוקים וכללים · 15", and the line about "חשבון ניירות ערך".

**Where I wasn't sure:**
- On the first screen there's a strange line: "123 מקור 123 מחושב 123 הזנחה, מונח הקישו להסבר". I didn't understand it.
- I didn't understand "מסלול מדד", "צמודה", "ריאלי" or "תקופת ההתנה". I also didn't understand the "47%" tax, or why the 7% return and 2% inflation were only "הנחות של האתר".
- The six years are counted from the first deposit, and for studies it's three years. I'm not sure I read that right.
- Between the first and second screens a line got cut off. Something about "7.5%" and a ceiling.

**What bothered me:**
- The page is dark with grey letters, and some lines, like the explanations under the chart, were small and pale. I couldn't read them properly even with my glasses.
- The chart screen was crowded and frightening.
- It's a site called "מקור", and I don't know who they are.
